instruction: Insert an 'Initials' column in column G and fill it with the first letters of each name part for every professor (for example, 'Qi Liu' should be 'QL').

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a new 'Initials' column (column G) that extracts the first letter of each name part from column B (Professor names).
